title: Snowflake's type names collapse
description: `TINYINT`, `SMALLINT`, `INT`, `INTEGER`, `BIGINT`, `BYTEINT`, `NUMBER`, `DECIMAL`, `NUMERIC` are `NUMBER(38,0)`; `FLOAT`, `FLOAT4`, `FLOAT8`, `DOUBLE`, `DOUBLE PRECISION`, `REAL` are `FLOAT`; `TIMESTAMP` and `DATETIME` are `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(9)`, `TIME` `TIME(9)`. `SYSTEM$TYPEOF` shows them.
reference: Types are explicit in the plan. sverify's SQL names `NUMBER(38,0)`, `FLOAT`, `TIMESTAMP_NTZ(6)`, `TIME(9)`, `DATE`, `VARCHAR`, `BOOLEAN`.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::TINYINT), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::SMALLINT), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::INT), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::INTEGER), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::BIGINT), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::BYTEINT), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::NUMBER), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::DECIMAL), SYSTEM$TYPEOF(1::NUMERIC)
evidence.observed: (NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1], NUMBER(38,0)[SB1])

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
